title: RFMapper Observation
description: One canonical radio observation recorded by one observer at one instant. This is the immutable RAW record; nothing downstream may edit it.

observation_id.description: Globally unique identifier. UUID v4 generated on the collecting device. Primary deduplication key across every observer and every import.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this observation contract. Consumers must reject majors they do not implement.

timestamp_utc.description: Instant of measurement, ISO-8601 in UTC with millisecond precision and a literal Z. Device wall clock; see metadata.clock_* keys for offset estimation.

observer_id.description: Identity of the collecting installation, e.g. OBS-04. Mandatory on every observation.

sensor_type.description: Which sensor produced this record. Determines which optional fields are meaningful.

target_device_id.description: Managed device this observation is attributed to. Null unless an explicit administrator enrollment rule matched. Never inferred from a randomized identifier.

radio_identifier.description: Normalized identifier actually observed: lowercase colon-separated MAC, lowercase UUID, or an SSID string. Normalization is deterministic (see RadioIdentifierNormalizer).

ssid.description: Network name where the platform exposes it. May be null even for WIFI_SCAN under restrictive permissions.

ble_service_uuid.description: First advertised service UUID, lowercase. Full list, when present, is in metadata.ble_service_uuids.

manufacturer_data.description: Uppercase hex, no separators, prefixed by the 4-hex-digit company identifier, e.g. '004C0215...'. Empty payloads are null, not an empty string.

rssi.description: Received signal strength in dBm as reported by the radio, uncalibrated. Normalization happens in DERIVED, never here.

tx_power.description: Advertised or reported transmit power in dBm.

channel.description: Channel number derived from frequency by the collector.

rtt_distance_mm.description: Genuine Wi-Fi RTT range in millimetres. Present only when sensor_type is RTT. Must never be back-filled from an RSSI model.

rtt_stddev_mm.description: Standard deviation of the RTT range in millimetres, as reported by the platform.

horizontal_accuracy.description: Platform-reported horizontal accuracy of the GNSS fix, in metres (68% confidence radius on Android).

building_id.description: Building the OBSERVER was in, as configured or declared at collection time. This is observer context, not an inference about the target.

zone_id.description: Zone the OBSERVER was in at collection time. Observer context, not a target estimate.

x_coordinate.description: Observer site-local X in metres, when known (survey/ground-truth capture, or a fixed observer).

y_coordinate.description: Observer site-local Y in metres, when known.

confidence.description: Collection-time measurement quality in [0,1]: how much this single sample should be trusted (freshness, scan completeness, permission degradation). It is NOT a position confidence.

metadata.description: Extensible string map. Keys listed in docs/02-observation-schema.md are reserved and have defined meanings; unknown keys must be preserved verbatim by every consumer.

allOf.$comment: RTT ranges only ever appear on RTT records.
A GNSS fix must carry both coordinates.
Site-local coordinates are meaningless without a building.
